name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop
description: Cross-platform Electron host for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --config.verifyDepsBeforeRun=false exec tsdown --config tsdown.preload.config.ts && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.package:win:x64: pnpm run build && node scripts/prepare-windows-runtime.mjs && node node_modules/electron-builder/out/cli/cli.js --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:macos:arm64: pnpm run build && node scripts/prepare-unix-runtime.mjs && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false node node_modules/electron-builder/out/cli/cli.js --config electron-builder.macos.yml --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:macos:x64: pnpm run build && node scripts/prepare-unix-runtime.mjs && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false node node_modules/electron-builder/out/cli/cli.js --config electron-builder.macos.yml --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux:x64: pnpm run build && node scripts/prepare-unix-runtime.mjs && node node_modules/electron-builder/out/cli/cli.js --config electron-builder.linux.yml --linux deb rpm --x64 --publish never
